items_list.fact: Reasoning RLVR is rarely single-objective: correct, but also length budgets, format constraints, safety, executability
items_list.where: The paper tab, Problem
checks: an answer must be correct, and also respect a length budget, a format, a safety rule

items_list.fact: Standard recipe scalarises r_sum = sum w_k r_k with fixed weights, then group-standardised GRPO advantage
items_list.where: The paper tab, Problem
checks: add the rewards with fixed weights
then standardise the sum within each group as GRPO does

items_list.fact: Failure 1: scalarisation loses reward resolution; with equal weights (1,0) and (0,1) indistinguishable; perfect format zero correctness reinforced as strongly as the reverse
items_list.where: The paper tab, Problem; Figure 1 animation
checks: reinforced as strongly as the reverse

items_list.fact: Failure 2: fixed weights ignore saturation; easy objectives saturate early yet keep the same share while correctness keeps headroom
items_list.where: The paper tab, Problem
checks: Easy auxiliary objectives (format, length) saturate early yet keep drawing the same share

items_list.fact: GDPO fixes problem 1 by per-group per-dimension normalisation before summing, not problem 2: fixed weights persist
items_list.where: The paper tab, Problem
checks: it standardises each reward separately within the group, then sums

items_list.fact: Concurrent methods DVAO, GD2PO, SAW, Focal Reward adapt by variance or agreement; none ties allocation to remaining attainable range
items_list.where: The paper tab, Problem
checks: GD2PO by conflicts between reward-specific advantages
Focal Reward by saturation of rubric criteria

items_list.fact: Setup: B queries, G >= 2 rollouts from frozen behaviour policy, n bounded verifiable objectives with bounds and weights
items_list.where: The paper tab, Method
checks: a batch of B questions, G ≥ 2 answers to each from the frozen sampling policy

items_list.fact: Per-objective group advantage A_k = (r_k - mu_k)/sigma_k (the GDPO part)
items_list.where: The paper tab, Method step 1

items_list.fact: Saturation ratio s_k = (rbar_k - r_min)/(r_max - r_min) in [0,1], rbar over all B x G rollouts; no estimation needed, bounds prescribed by the reward function
items_list.where: The paper tab, Method step 2
checks: Nothing is estimated: for bounded rule-based rewards the bounds come with the reward function

items_list.fact: Aggregation wtilde_k = w_k (1 - s_k)^gamma, Atilde = sum wtilde_k A_k
items_list.where: The paper tab, Method step 3

items_list.fact: Re-standardise Atilde over the whole batch to keep the advantage scale stable; plugs into the standard clipped GRPO surrogate
items_list.where: The paper tab, Method step 4
checks: goes into the standard clipped GRPO surrogate unchanged

items_list.fact: Wall-clock overhead a few batch means, essentially zero
items_list.where: The paper tab, Method, Cost (marked as derived: the paper reports no timing)
checks: the paper reports no timing, but the extra work is negligible beside sampling

items_list.fact: gamma = 0 recovers GDPO exactly; single objective reduces to GRPO
items_list.where: The paper tab, Method, Special cases

items_list.fact: gamma is the single knob: ratio wtilde_a/wtilde_b = (w_a/w_b)((1-s_a)/(1-s_b))^gamma, strictly decreasing in gamma when a more saturated
items_list.where: The paper tab, Method; Tables tab checks
checks: strictly decreasing in γ when a is the more saturated
